baselines.name: PD-SSM
baselines.paper: Structured Sparse Transition Matrices to Enable State Tracking in State-Space Models
baselines.code_runnable_in_current_environment: UNKNOWN - not executed in this audit because Step 5a forbids experiment runs and git commands are disallowed for this round.
baselines.environment_notes: Repository is Python and Apache-2.0 licensed per GitHub page. It targets FSA state-tracking and long-sequence tasks, but this audit did not install or run it.
baselines.supports_custom_finite_group_state_track: Likely partially. The public README describes FSA state tracking and algebraic-group automata, including non-solvable examples, but direct support for the exact held-out transition-pair generator protocol is not confirmed without inspecting and adapting its data pipeline.
baselines.adaptable_without_model_rewrite: Potentially yes for the model, but not just by changing a config file. A custom data adapter and output/readout mapping for the held-out transition-pair split would be required.
baselines.estimated_engineering_time: 1-2 days for a fair adapter and smoke run; 3-5 days for paper-grade matched seeds, manifests, and failure-case logging.
baselines.reason: Official code exists and the method is directly relevant, but immediate run-now status is not justified without building an adapter and validating parity with the existing split/manifests.
